en.title: Forza Horizon 1 ReImagined (FH1): Native PC Recomp Status
en.description: Forza Horizon (Xbox 360) recompiled to run natively on Windows and Linux, with online play restored via Forza Live. Bring your own copy of the game.
en.subtitle: Forza Horizon (Xbox 360, 2012) native PC recompilation

en.title: Horizon: Minecraft Java Edition Rewritten in Rust – Status
en.description: Native Rust rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 that reads vanilla worlds and joins vanilla servers. Needs a Microsoft account that owns Java Edition.
en.subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust

en.title: MeitouClient: Kenshi Engine Reimplementation – Status
en.description: Early playable C#/.NET 10 reimplementation of the Kenshi engine with a Vulkan renderer. Launcher for Windows, Linux and macOS; needs your own Kenshi copy.
en.subtitle: Kenshi engine reimplementation in C# / Vulkan

en.title: OpenYAMM: Might and Magic 6–8 Engine – Status & Setup
en.description: Playable C++ reimplementation of Might and Magic VI–VIII with HD art, new menus and cross-game travel. Needs original MM6–8 data; Windows, Linux, Android.
en.subtitle: Might and Magic VI–VIII engine reimplementation

en.title: OpenSmash Ultimate: SSBU PC Recomp – Status & Requirements
en.description: Static recompilation of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4/13.0.5 for Windows x64. Tools and runtime only; you supply your own copy. Online is experimental.
en.subtitle: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate static recompilation for PC

en.title: OpenTS: Tiberian Sun Open-Source Engine – Status
en.description: Community open-source reconstruction of the Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun engine for play and modding. Not an EA remaster; original game assets required.
en.subtitle: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun engine reconstruction

en.title: Code Veronica Recomp: RE CVX PS3 to PC Port – Status
en.description: Unofficial native Windows port of Resident Evil Code: Veronica X via ps3recomp static recompilation. Needs your own PSN 01.00 copy; launcher included.
en.subtitle: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X (PS3) native Windows port

en.title: San Andreas Unity: Open-Source GTA SA Engine – Status
en.description: Open-source GTA San Andreas engine reimplementation in Unity with multiplayer and modding. Not a complete reimplementation; needs a PC GTA SA install.
en.subtitle: GTA San Andreas engine reimplementation in Unity

en.title: OpenReliant: StarLancer Engine Reimplementation – Status
en.description: Beta open-source StarLancer (2000) engine in Zig with a playable single-player campaign on Linux, macOS and Windows. Requires retail StarLancer assets.
en.subtitle: StarLancer (2000) engine reimplementation

en.title: OpenTS2: Open-Source The Sims 2 Engine – Status
en.description: Early open-source reimplementation of The Sims 2 in Unity with C# file-format libraries. Main menu and neighborhood view so far; needs Sims 2 UC installed.
en.subtitle: The Sims 2 reimplementation in Unity
